name: before_1942
sql: select id, tier, open_price, open_at, open_is_opener, ref_price, ref_at, cur_price, cur_at, pct_10m, pct_open, cur_src, sent_at, move_delay_s, message from ten280_bot.alerts where id = 1942

name: install_v3_selftest_gate
after_1942
sql: select a.id, ten280_bot.render(a, coalesce(a.sent_at, a.eval_at)) as message from ten280_bot.alerts a where a.id = 1942

name: format_test_v3
delivery_v3
sql: select ten280_bot.settle(); select e.id, e.kind, e.delivery, e.created_at, r.status_code, (r.content::jsonb -> 'result' ->> 'text') = (e.detail ->> 'text') as text_identical from ten280_bot.events e left join net._http_response r on r.id = e.net_request_id where e.kind = 'format_test_v3'

name: cron_jobs
sql: select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job order by jobname

name: pg_cron_version
sql: select extname, extversion from pg_extension where extname in ('pg_cron','pg_net')

name: cron_health
sql: select count(*) runs, count(*) filter (where d.status <> 'succeeded') failed, max(d.end_time - d.start_time) max_took from cron.job_run_details d join cron.job j using (jobid) where j.jobname = 'ten280-bet105-drop-bot' and d.start_time > now() - interval '3 hours'

name: live_delay
sql: select tier, cur_src, count(*) n, percentile_cont(array[0.5,0.9]) within group (order by move_delay_s) delay_s, percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from eval_at - cur_at)) detect_s from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='live' and move_delay_s is not null group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: live_alerts
sql: select id, eval_at, tier, cur_src, cur_at, sent_at, move_delay_s, delivery from ten280_bot.alerts where mode='live' order by id

name: poller_lag_24h
sql: select f.league_id, count(*) n, percentile_cont(array[0.5,0.9]) within group (order by extract(epoch from o.observed_at - o.inserted_on)) lag_s from public.kibl_line_observations o join public.kibl_fixtures f using (fixture_id) where o.feed_source_id = 171 and o.market_type_id = 1 and o.is_live is false and f.league_id in (19,537,962) and o.inserted_on > now() - interval '24 hours' and not coalesce(o.is_opener,false) group by 1 order by 1

name: stream_leagues_24h
sql: select f.league_id, count(*) n from public.kibl_now_history h join public.kibl_fixtures f using (fixture_id) where h.kibl_inserted_on > now() - interval '24 hours' group by 1 order by 1

name: now_heartbeat
sql: select written_at, note from public.kibl_now_price where kind = 'heartbeat'
